tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List Sevalla services
tools.description: Lists the applications, static sites and databases in the Sevalla account with status, names and the IDs other tools take. One service in detail: get_application, get_static_site, get_database. Pipelines, projects, load balancers, buckets and lists by status, source or engine: sevalla_api_read.

type.description: One service type only. Default: all.

project_id.description: Project ID; filters applications and databases.

offset.description: Services skipped per type, for paging.

tools.name: get_application
tools.title: Get Sevalla application
tools.description: Returns a Sevalla application with its processes (web, worker, cron, job) with scaling, probes, disks and job timing, domains with DNS records and verification errors, and latest deployment. History: list_deployments. Logs: search_runtime_logs, get_deployment_logs.

detail.description: full adds every field the API returns.

tools.name: get_static_site
tools.title: Get Sevalla static site
tools.description: Returns a Sevalla static site with its build settings, domains with DNS records and verification errors, and latest deployment. History: list_deployments.

detail.description: full adds every field the API returns.

tools.name: get_database
tools.title: Get Sevalla database
tools.description: Returns a Sevalla database: engine, version, status, size, internal and external endpoints, recent backups and internal connections to applications. Passwords are not included. Usage over time: get_metrics.

detail.description: full adds every field the API returns.

tools.name: get_platform_options
tools.title: Get Sevalla regions and sizes
tools.description: Lists Sevalla regions (clusters) and machine sizes for application processes and databases, with CPU, memory and storage limits. create_application, create_database and scale_process take these IDs.

kind.description: Sizes for one kind only. Default: both.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.title: List Sevalla deployments
tools.description: Lists deployments of a Sevalla application or static site, newest first, with status, trigger, branch, commit and timing.

service_type.description: Kind of service that service_id refers to.

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.title: Get Sevalla deployment
tools.description: Returns a deployment of a Sevalla application or static site: status, steps, branch, commit, image and timing. It reports the progress of deployments started by trigger_deployment or rollback_deployment. Output and failure causes: get_deployment_logs.

service_type.description: Kind of service that service_id refers to.

detail.description: full adds every field the API returns.

tools.name: get_deployment_logs
tools.title: Get Sevalla deployment logs
tools.description: Returns the build and rollout log of a deployment of a Sevalla application or static site, one line per entry, by default the last 100 lines. errors_only keeps lines mentioning errors, failures or exceptions. Running application logs: search_runtime_logs.

service_type.description: Kind of service that service_id refers to.

errors_only.description: Only lines that look like errors.

tools.name: trigger_deployment
tools.title: Deploy Sevalla service
tools.description: Starts a deployment of a Sevalla application or static site: by default the latest commit of the default branch. Applications can also deploy a specific commit or rebuild without the build cache. It runs asynchronously and replaces the running version when it succeeds; get_deployment reports progress.

service_type.description: Kind of service that service_id refers to.

branch.description: Branch to deploy instead of the default branch.

commit_sha.description: Applications only: full 40-character SHA of a commit on the branch.

docker_image.description: Image to deploy, for Docker-based applications.

restart.description: Applications only: redeploy the current build without rebuilding.

skip_build_cache.description: Applications only: rebuild without the build cache.

tools.name: rollback_deployment
tools.title: Roll back Sevalla service
tools.description: Rolls a Sevalla application or static site back to an earlier successful deployment. Applications redeploy the build of their most recent successful one. Static sites rebuild the commit of deployment_id or, by default, of the last successful one before the current, with the current settings and variables. get_deployment reports progress.

service_type.description: Kind of service that service_id refers to.

deployment_id.description: Static sites only: deployment to redeploy.

tools.name: search_runtime_logs
tools.title: Search Sevalla runtime logs
tools.description: Returns runtime logs (stdout and stderr of running processes) of a Sevalla application: the latest entries of a time window (default last 60 minutes), oldest first, one line each. Build output: get_deployment_logs. HTTP requests: search_access_logs.

since_minutes.description: Window length in minutes, ending at end_time. Default 60.

end_time.description: Window end as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Default now.

severity.description: Only this severity; ERROR includes all stderr output.

search.description: Only entries whose message contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: search_access_logs
tools.title: Search Sevalla access logs
tools.description: Returns HTTP access logs of a Sevalla application or static site: the latest requests of a time window (default last 60 minutes), oldest first, with status, method, path and client details. Aggregated traffic and error rates: get_metrics.

service_type.description: Kind of service that service_id refers to.

since_minutes.description: Window length in minutes, ending at end_time. Default 60.

end_time.description: Window end as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Default now.

path_prefix.description: Only paths starting with this text.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.title: Get Sevalla metrics
tools.description: Returns metrics of a Sevalla application or static site (traffic, response times, status codes, top pages and countries, slowest requests), a process (CPU, memory, instances, exit codes) or a database (CPU, memory, storage), by default for the last 60 minutes. Series are summarized as min, max, avg, last and a downsampled series.

metrics.description: Default: a standard set. application, static_site: requests_per_minute, response_time_ms, average_response_time_ms, status_codes, top_status_codes, top_countries, slowest_requests, top_pages. process: cpu_usage_cores, cpu_limit_cores, memory_usage_bytes, memory_limit_bytes, instance_count, exit_codes. database: cpu_usage_cores, cpu_limit_cores, memory_usage_bytes, memory_limit_bytes, storage_usage_bytes, storage_limit_bytes, allocated_storage_bytes, used_storage_bytes.

status.description: application, static_site: only requests with this status code (404) or class (5xx).

path_prefix.description: application, static_site: only paths starting with this text.

since_minutes.description: Window length in minutes, ending at end_time. Default 60.

end_time.description: Window end as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Default now.

tools.name: list_environment_variables
tools.title: List Sevalla environment variables
tools.description: Lists the environment variables of a Sevalla application, static site or the company-wide global set, with their build, runtime, preview and branch scoping. Stored values are withheld.

scope.description: One application, one static site, or global (company-wide variables every application inherits unless it sets the same key).

service_id.description: Application or static site ID (list_services). Not used with scope global.

tools.name: set_environment_variables
tools.title: Set Sevalla environment variables
tools.description: Creates or updates environment variables of a Sevalla application, static site or the company-wide global set; other variables stay unchanged and values are never echoed. Changes apply at the next deployment.

scope.description: One application, one static site, or global (company-wide variables every application inherits unless it sets the same key).

service_id.description: Application or static site ID (list_services). Not used with scope global.

runtime.description: Applications, global: available at runtime (new: true).

buildtime.description: Applications, global: available during builds (new: true).

production.description: Static sites: used in production (new: true).

preview.description: Static sites: used in previews (new: true).

redeploy.description: Deploy afterwards so the change takes effect now (applications and static sites).

tools.name: delete_environment_variables
tools.title: Delete Sevalla environment variables
tools.description: Deletes environment variables by key from a Sevalla application, static site or the company-wide global set. Changes apply at the next deployment.

scope.description: One application, one static site, or global (company-wide variables every application inherits unless it sets the same key).

service_id.description: Application or static site ID (list_services). Not used with scope global.

redeploy.description: Deploy afterwards so the change takes effect now (applications and static sites).

tools.name: scale_process
tools.title: Scale Sevalla process
tools.description: Sets how a Sevalla application process scales: fixed instances or an autoscaling range, and/or its machine size. Bigger sizes and more instances cost more. By default the application restarts from its current build so the change applies now. The start command, port, health checks and cron schedule are other fields of updateProcessV3, which sevalla_api_update runs.

instances.description: Fixed instance count; 0 stops the process.

autoscaling.description: Autoscaling range with CPU and/or memory targets.

apply_now.description: Restart now so the change applies.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.title: Add Sevalla custom domain
tools.description: Adds a custom domain to a Sevalla application or static site and returns the DNS records to create at the DNS provider. Sevalla then verifies them and issues SSL, or serves a custom certificate when one is given; get_application or get_static_site shows the status.

service_type.description: Kind of service that service_id refers to.

ssl_certificate.description: Custom SSL certificate (PEM, with its chain) instead of an issued one.

ssl_private_key.description: PEM private key of ssl_certificate; not returned.

tools.name: create_application
tools.title: Create Sevalla application
tools.description: Creates a Sevalla application from a Git repository or Docker image with one web process, and by default starts its first deployment. It is billed by the size and number of its process instances.

display_name.description: Display name of the new application.

source.description: privateGit: via the account GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket connection. publicGit: a public repository URL.

git_type.description: Provider, when not detectable from the URL.

default_branch.description: Branch to deploy. Default: repository default.

docker_image.description: Image, e.g. nginx:1.27, for source dockerImage.

project_id.description: Project to add the service to.

tools.name: create_static_site
tools.title: Create Sevalla static site
tools.description: Creates a Sevalla static site from a Git repository and starts its first build.

display_name.description: Display name of the new static site.

source.description: privateGit: via the account Git connection. publicGit: a public repository.

git_type.description: Provider, when not detectable from the URL.

allow_deploy_paths.description: Only pushes changing these globs deploy.

ignore_deploy_paths.description: Pushes changing only these globs skip deployment.

project_id.description: Project to add the service to.

tools.name: create_database
tools.title: Create Sevalla database
tools.description: Creates a managed Sevalla database (billed by size). Its password is generated on the server and never returned. connect_to_application_id also connects it to that application and stores the connection URL in the application variable env_var_name, unless that variable already exists. Provisioning is asynchronous; get_database shows when it is ready.

display_name.description: Display name of the new database.

version.description: Engine version, e.g. 17 for PostgreSQL. Default: the newest in the cluster.

project_id.description: Project to add the service to.

connect_to_application_id.description: Application in the same region to connect.

env_var_name.description: Variable that receives the connection URL.

tools.name: search_sevalla_docs
tools.title: Search Sevalla documentation
tools.description: Searches the Sevalla documentation (docs.sevalla.com): features, settings, limits, builds, frameworks and migration guides. Returns the best-matching pages with their most relevant section. It reads public docs, not the account.

query.description: What to look up, e.g. "nixpacks node version".

tools.name: sevalla_api_search
tools.title: Search Sevalla API operations
tools.description: Searches all 252 operations of the Sevalla API v3 (reference: https://api-docs.sevalla.com), including those behind dedicated tools, by keywords and returns their IDs, parameters, body fields and the tool that runs each. 180 have no dedicated tool, among them the clone, suspend, cancel and promote operations. operation_id returns one operation in full. It reads the API reference, not the account.

tools.name: sevalla_api_read
tools.title: Read from the Sevalla API
tools.description: Runs one read-only (GET) operation of the Sevalla API v3 (reference: https://api-docs.sevalla.com) by operation ID, for data without a dedicated tool: projects, pipelines, load balancers, buckets, webhooks, usage alerts, repository files, users, API keys and more.

operation_id.description: Operation ID from sevalla_api_search, e.g. listProjectsV3.

tools.name: sevalla_api_create
tools.title: Create through the Sevalla API
tools.description: Runs one operation of the Sevalla API v3 (reference: https://api-docs.sevalla.com) that only adds something new, by operation ID: a project, pipeline, process, backup, bucket, webhook, load balancer and the like. New resources may be billed.

operation_id.description: Operation ID from sevalla_api_search, e.g. listProjectsV3.

tools.name: sevalla_api_update
tools.title: Update through the Sevalla API
tools.description: Runs one operation of the Sevalla API v3 (reference: https://api-docs.sevalla.com) that changes existing state, by operation ID: settings updates, suspend or activate, database restart or backup restore, pipeline promotion, cache purges, maintenance mode, or a command in a running process (execProcessCommandV3).

operation_id.description: Operation ID from sevalla_api_search, e.g. listProjectsV3.

tools.name: sevalla_api_delete
tools.title: Delete through the Sevalla API
tools.description: Permanently deletes one resource through an operation of the Sevalla API v3 (reference: https://api-docs.sevalla.com) by operation ID: from a domain, process, backup, webhook or API key up to an entire application, static site, database, pipeline, project, load balancer or bucket.

operation_id.description: Operation ID from sevalla_api_search, e.g. listProjectsV3.
